web-guide-idea-26.audience: Makers and viewers who enjoy watching an object take shape.
web-guide-idea-26.offer: Host a focused making session with a visible milestone. Explain why you choose a material or technique instead of silently working for an hour.
web-guide-idea-26.steps.0: Choose a safe stage that fits the session.
web-guide-idea-26.steps.1: Demonstrate each major step with the work clearly framed.
web-guide-idea-26.steps.2: Show progress and explain what remains for the next stage.
web-guide-idea-26.equipment: A phone on a stand and the tools your project needs. Position the camera before using sharp or powered equipment.
web-guide-idea-26.returnReason: Turn longer projects into clearly named chapters with a tangible result in each.
web-guide-idea-26.promotion: Share the starting object and the milestone you expect to reach, without promising an unrealistic finish.
web-guide-idea-26.metadataTitle: Build Something Live — Creator Idea & Practical Guide · avaTOK
web-guide-idea-26.metadataDescription: Let viewers follow a miniature, furniture restoration, sewing project or handmade prop from start to finish. Learn what to offer, how to start and what equipment you need.
